discription: A simple FM synthesis patch creating bell-like or metallic sounds with a quick attack and decay. The modulation index also decays, contributing to the evolving timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, modFreqRatio=1.4, modIndex=5.0; var sig, env, modEnv; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.001, 0.1, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); modEnv = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.001, 0.2, 0.3, 0.8, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); var modFreq = freq * modFreqRatio; var modulator = SinOsc.ar(modFreq); sig = SinOsc.ar(freq + (modulator * (modIndex * modEnv))); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
